origine_fr: La main 扌 et 奄 (écrit 大 sur 电), qui donne le son (yǎn). La main se referme pour couvrir. 掩 veut dire « couvrir, cacher », comme dans 掩盖.
origine_en: The hand 扌 with 奄 (written 大 over 电), which gives the sound (yǎn). The hand closes over something to cover it. 掩 means “to cover, to hide”, as in 掩盖.

phrase.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yǎngài zìjǐ de cuòwù.
phrase.en: He wants to cover up his mistake.
